market_summary: Market mood is bullish-volatile, driven by two big catalysts: (1) the IEM Cologne Major Stage 2/3 is in full swing, and (2) a wave of Chinese buyer activity is pumping gloves, knives and case items 30-50%, compounded by a crypto crash (Bitcoin ~$60k) that historically rotates capital into CS2 skins. Most extreme price swings are concentrated in Doppler/Gamma-Doppler knives, which spiked to highs then crashed back near 7-day lows — these now sit at deeply discounted entries while Chinese demand persists. Biggest risk is the souvenir-crafting Valve exploit that obliterated souvenir/collectible values (Glock Candy Apple, R8 Bone Mask etc.), so avoid souvenir and crafted-souvenir items entirely. Liquidity is thin on many top-swing knives (vol<10), so favor names with vol>15 for clean entry/exit.
